title: Modular Courses at Institutes of Higher Learning that Teach Future Economy Skills
what_it_is: Modular Courses at Institutes of Higher Learning that Teach Future Economy Skills

sections.label: Short modular industry-aligned courses
sections.summary: MOE/SSG supported courses at Autonomous Universities and Polytechnics rose from about 2,200 to 2,600 between 2015 and 2016, giving about 90,000 and 105,000 training places.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills)
sentences.text: Over the years, they have been increasing the number and range of short modular courses that are aligned to industry needs and in support of SkillsFuture.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills)
sentences.text: Between 2015 and 2016, the number of MOE/SSG supported courses offered by our Autonomous Universities and Polytechnics increased from about 2,200 to approximately 2,600.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills)
sentences.text: Many of these courses are in the areas of Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, including information and communication technology.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills)
sentences.text: This translated to about 90,000 and 105,000 training places in 2015 and 2016 respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills)
sentences.text: We can expect this number to be ramped up significantly in the coming years.

sections.label: Outreach and communication of courses
sections.summary: The Member is assured that outreach and communication on courses is done with Autonomous Universities, Polytechnics and all training providers, and this approach will continue.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I agree that we need to make sure that our courses are widely spread out in terms of the outreach as well as communication to the people.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I want to assure the Member that we have been doing this, not only with the AUs and the Polytechnics, but we have also been doing this with all the training providers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will continue this approach and process to make sure that we want to facilitate how we want to change the educational landscape in the future.
